## Checklist

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (or CI ran it)
- [ ] New or changed text is in every language (`src/i18n/<lang>/`, `src/learn/content/<lang>/`)
- [ ] Bidding or play changes keep the bots language-independent and, for bidding, were measured against par
- [ ] Tried in the browser, including phone width
